description: Java class 'SavingsAccountChargeRepositoryWrapper' that serves as a wrapper for 'SavingsAccountChargeRepository', adding null checking and custom error handling for savings account charges in the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for the savings account charge repository, providing additional null checking and exception handling.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a savings account charge by ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a savings account charge by ID and savings account ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: findPendingCharges
methods.description: Returns a list of pending charges for a given transaction date.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and immediately flushes a savings account charge to the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified savings account charge.
